# Operations Service Standards and Efficiency Review

This document outlines several key operational tasks and updates required:

*   Update the teller performance based on audit findings.
*   Investigate the branch efficiency quarterly.
*   Update the customer wait time standard.
*   Review the teller performance urgently.
*   Update the branch efficiency standard.
